hypotheses.justification: `[NumberField L]` is instance-implicit and its type mentions only `L`, which is already an argument, so the theorem takes it; only `IsGalois K L` is omitted. Nothing in the statement or proof needs it. `AutomorphicForm.sigmaTensor` (Def_AutomorphicForm_TwistedOrbital.lean, lines 196-200) only requires `[Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]` and is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ.toAlgHom (AlgHom.id K A)`. The completion `Kv = adicCompletion K v` with `v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)` needs `IsDedekindDomain (𝓞 K)`, which comes from `NumberField K`, not `NumberField L`. The proof rewrites with `sigmaTensor_pow` (same file, lines 43-47, stated with only the field/algebra assumptions) and then uses `map_mul` for the ring hom `sigmaTensor K L Kv (σ^i)`; neither uses `NumberField L`. The statement holds for any field extension L/K, since an iterate of a ring hom is multiplicative. So `omit [IsGalois K L] [NumberField L] in` works with the same proof.
